title: Enterprise  partnerships Lead
description:
Job Description: Enterprise Partnerships Lead
  
  
Company: Glaring Labs (early-stage fintech)
  
Location: Kochi / Mumbai (frequent travel)
  
Experience: 5+ years
  
Reports to: Founder/CEO
  
  
About Glaring Labs
  
  
Glaring Labs is building a new commerce-linked financial product that helps large merchants drive committed customer spend and repeat purchases. We work with regulated banking and financial partners. We're pre-launch and hiring the person who will sign our first enterprise merchants.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You will own enterprise merchant acquisition end-to-end: pitch, commercial negotiation, legal and procurement, and go-live. This is a closer's role, not a lead-generation role.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
• Build and close the pipeline. Build and close a pipeline of large enterprise merchants across retail, utilities, fuel, and consumer categories.
  
• Sell at the right level. Sell to CFO, CMO, Head of Loyalty, and Head of Payments, and map the full buying committee.
  
• Negotiate commercial partnership agreements. Own the terms, pricing, and co-marketing commitments.
  
• Build business cases. Show the merchant's revenue, customer acquisition cost, and working capital impact.
  
• Run public-sector processes. Navigate PSU procurement, including empanelment, tenders, and committee approvals.
  
• Coordinate internally. Work with our banking partners and tech team so that what you sell is deliverable.
  
• Drive time-to-live. Push from signature to live integration.
  
• Feed the product. Bring structured merchant feedback into the roadmap.
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  
• 5+ years of B2B enterprise sales or partnerships, with at least 4 years selling to large retailers, PSUs, or national brands.
  
• A proven record of closing multi-crore annual contracts with 6–12 month cycles.
  
• Background in payments, merchant acquiring, affordability or EMI programs, loyalty, or bank merchant partnerships.
  
• A strong grasp of merchant economics, including MDR, settlement cycles, and promotional funding.
  
• Existing CXO-level relationships at large Indian retailers or PSUs.
  
• Comfort negotiating MSAs with legal and procurement.
  
• Malayalam is a plus.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
• Experience selling to government bodies or state utilities.
  
• Exposure to RBI-regulated products.
  
• Having been the first sales hire at an early-stage startup.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Timeline Target
  
90 days 2 enterprise merchants at term-sheet stage
  
6 months 2 merchants signed and live, and a PSU empanelment underway
  
12 months 8+ live enterprise merchants
  
  
Compensation
  
  
Competitive fixed pay, a significant performance variable, and ESOPs.

title: Assistant Manager - Entertainment PRS, Malayalam
description:
* Job Summary To work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster. The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.

The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.
* Developing insights into the genre & channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
* Creating & implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact
* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows. Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.
* Liaise with the Programming teams and build a thorough understanding of the channel objectives and performance in order to identify monetization opportunities, as also provide market / sales feedback in relation to channel properties
* Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective
* Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients’ buys
* Skills & Attributes for success

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strategic planning
* Influencing Skills
* Result Orientation
* Negotiation Skills
* Analytical thinking
* Strategic planning
* Leadership
* Preferred Education & Experience

Minimum Qualification: MBA
  
  

* 5+ years of post-qualification experience
* Business consulting/ strategy background preferred
* About Us (Boilerplate)

*Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and steaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.*

title: Pricing & Customer Service
description:
**Company Description**
QATLOG, is a freight forwarding and logistics group delivering fast, smart global transportation solutions for businesses of all sizes. The company provides comprehensive, tailored services that connect clients to markets worldwide through reliable shipment management. QATLOG emphasizes exceptional customer service and efficient logistics to support long-term client growth. Team members work in a dynamic, international environment with opportunities to collaborate across functions and regions. The organization values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement in all aspects of its operations.

This is a full-time, on-site Pricing & Customer Service. The role includes handling customer inquiries via phone and email, providing shipment updates, resolving service issues, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. Collaboration with operations, sales, and finance teams is required to ensure smooth execution of logistics solutions and consistent service quality.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, make sound decisions, and manage multiple priorities.
* Basic proficiency in POS systems and restaurant management software; comfort with reporting and documentation.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred, but equivalent experience will be considered.

title: AM Overseas Indian Support
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
  
  
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage client relationships.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**Job Description: Business Development Intern**

 

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India (Remote / Hybrid)
 

**Internship Duration:**
6 Months
(flexible)

 

**Type:**
Paid Internship
 

**Opportunity:**
Potential extension or full-time employment based on performance and business requirements
 

**About the Role**

 

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Business Development Intern with a genuine interest in technology sales, business growth, and client engagement.
 

This opportunity is designed for individuals who want to build a career in business development and technology sales. You will work closely with experienced professionals, learn how technology services are positioned and sold, research potential clients, identify business opportunities, and participate in real-world sales activities.
 

We value interest, initiative, communication skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn more than prior sales experience. You should be eager to learn, take ownership, and develop your skills through practical experience.
 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* **Market Research and Prospect Identification:**
  Research target industries, companies, and potential clients to identify relevant business opportunities in domestic and international markets.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Identify and build lists of prospective clients using professional networks, online research, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* **Client Outreach:**
  Assist with email outreach, LinkedIn engagement, follow-ups, and other professional communication to initiate conversations with potential clients.
* **Understanding Technology Solutions:**
  Learn about software development, product engineering, AI/ML, cloud solutions, and IT staffing services to understand client needs and communicate our offerings effectively.
* **Business Opportunity Development:**
  Assist in identifying client requirements, qualifying leads, understanding business challenges, and evaluating potential sales opportunities.
* **CRM and Sales Pipeline Management:**
  Maintain accurate records of leads, interactions, follow-ups, and opportunity status.
* **Industry and Competitor Research:**
  Track market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging opportunities in technology services.
* **Team Collaboration:**
  Work closely with business development and technical teams to understand client requirements and support the sales process from initial outreach to opportunity development.

**What We Are Looking For**

 

We are looking for potential, attitude, and commitment rather than a long list of prior qualifications.
 

* **Genuine Interest in Business Development:**
  A clear interest in sales, business growth, client relationships, and understanding how businesses acquire customers.
* **Strong English Communication Skills:**
  Good spoken and written English is essential, particularly for professional emails, client conversations, and international business communication.
* **Interest in Technology:**
  Curiosity about software, digital products, emerging technologies, and how technology solves business problems.
* **Proactive Mindset:**
  Willingness to take initiative, explore opportunities, ask questions, and move tasks forward without constant supervision.
* **Research and Analytical Skills:**
  Ability to research companies, understand markets, identify relevant prospects, and organize information.
* **Confidence and Professionalism:**
  Comfortable communicating with new people, learning to approach potential clients, and receiving feedback.
* **Learning Agility:**
  Willingness to learn new concepts, understand technology offerings, and improve through practical experience.
* **Persistence and Resilience:**
  Ability to handle rejection positively, remain consistent with follow-ups, and learn from unsuccessful attempts.
* **Ownership and Accountability:**
  Commitment to completing assigned tasks, maintaining discipline, and taking responsibility for results.

**5. Who Can Apply?**

 

* **Educational Qualification:**
  Candidates from any academic background with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a genuine interest in business development and technology sales are welcome to apply.
* **Preferred Qualifications:**
  Graduates and postgraduates in Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Commerce (B.Com), Engineering (B.Tech/B.E.), Computer Applications (BCA/MCA), or related disciplines will be preferred.
* **Freshers Welcome:**
  Prior work experience is not mandatory. We value candidates with the right attitude, learning mindset, communication skills, and a genuine passion for building a career in business development.

 

**6. What You Will Gain**

 

* **Entry into Technology Sales:**
  Build a strong foundation in B2B business development, IT services sales, lead generation, and client acquisition.
* **International Market Exposure:**
  Learn how to identify, approach, and engage prospective clients across international markets.
* **Real-World Learning:**
  Work on actual business opportunities and gain practical exposure to real sales scenarios rather than relying solely on classroom training.
* **Mentorship from Experienced Professionals:**
  Receive guidance, feedback, and training from experienced team members.
* **Technology and Industry Knowledge:**
  Develop an understanding of software services, digital transformation, AI/ML, cloud engineering, and technology consulting.
* **Professional Skill Development:**
  Improve communication, presentation, research, relationship-building, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* **Career Growth Opportunity:**
  High-performing interns may be considered for an internship extension or a full-time role, subject to performance and business requirements.
* **Certificate:**

  Certificate upon successful completion of the internship.

title: Sales Advisor-Part Time-Fixed Term
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

→ Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.

→ Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.

→ Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.

→ Support with opening and closing of the store.

→ Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for people with…

→ Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.

And people who are…

→ Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.

→ Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.

→ Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.

→ Flexible and action oriented.

**WHO WE ARE**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.

· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.

· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.

· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.

· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

**JOIN US**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

\*\* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

**Additional Information**

This is a Part-time position for our store in Kochi. The position reports to the Store Manager.

title: Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
description:
Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
  
  
Company: HALBEX Private Limited
  
Location:Kochi / location to be finalised
  
Work Mode: On-site
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About HALBEX
  
  
HALBEX is building a B2B international export marketplace focused exclusively on halal FMCG food products sourced from India and supplied to international buyers.
  
  
We follow a merchant-trader model in which HALBEX manages the commercial transaction between Indian suppliers and international buyers, coordinating product compliance, seller onboarding, export documentation, and logistics.
  
  
We are currently in the pre-launch stage, preparing for our planned commercial launch in March 2027.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on professional to join HALBEX's founding team and help build our food sourcing and export operations from the ground up.
  
  
The first priority is to identify reliable Indian farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and suppliers who can provide export-quality spices, dry fruits, and grains at competitive prices.
  
  
The selected candidate will work directly with the founder and gradually establish the supplier network, product onboarding processes, compliance data, logistics partnerships, and shipment execution workflow required for HALBEX.
  
  
This is a founding-stage role requiring practical execution, independent research, supplier coordination, and ownership of day-to-day operational tasks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Supplier Sourcing & Price Comparison
  
  
- Identify major sourcing regions for spices, dry fruits, and grains across India.
  
- Find and contact farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and export-ready suppliers.
  
- Collect comparable quotations and evaluate prices, quality, MOQ, production capacity, packaging, and delivery timelines.
  
- Identify competitive suppliers while ensuring products meet the required quality and export standards.
  
- Build and maintain a verified supplier database.
  
  
2. Product Development & Seller Onboarding
  
  
- Collect supplier company documents and product specifications.
  
- Verify product details, packaging sizes, weights, supply capacity, and export readiness.
  
- Coordinate supplier registration and product listing on HALBEX.
  
- Ensure required information and documents are collected before product approval.
  
  
3. Product-Country Compliance Data
  
  
- Research applicable food-export requirements using official government and regulatory sources.
  
- Develop structured compliance records for each priority product and destination country.
  
- Identify applicable certificates, testing requirements, labelling rules, restrictions, and supporting evidence.
  
- Record source references, verification status, and responsible parties.
  
- Coordinate with the founder and technology team to implement the verified requirements in the platform.
  
  
4. Logistics Vendor Onboarding
  
  
- Identify freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping partners, and other relevant logistics providers.
  
- Collect and compare freight quotations.
  
- Establish procedures for shipment planning, documentation, and logistics coordination.
  
  
5. Buyer Order & Shipment Execution
  
  
- Coordinate supplier confirmation, product availability, compliance approval, and shipment planning.
  
- Support buyer orders and export documentation.
  
- Coordinate the complete process from supplier selection to delivery.
  
- Help execute HALBEX's first commercial export shipment through the online platform.
  
  
Initial Six-Month Roadmap
  
  
Month Main target
  
  
November 2026 Research sourcing regions and identify competitive suppliers
  
December 2026 Verify suppliers, collect product data, begin seller onboarding and compliance research
  
January 2027 Expand product compliance data and onboard logistics vendors
  
February 2027 Test the end-to-end order and shipment workflow
  
March 2027 Support buyer onboarding and work towards the first commercial shipment
  
April 2027 Review operations, improve processes, and expand the supplier network
  
  
  
These are proposed targets and will be finalised according to operational readiness and available resources.
  
  
Required Experience
  
  
- Experience in food-product sourcing, agricultural commodities, spices, dry fruits, grains, or food exports.
  
- Practical experience identifying and negotiating with suppliers.
  
- Understanding of product specifications, quality requirements, pricing, and supply capacity.
  
- Familiarity with export documentation and international logistics.
  
- Ability to research regulatory requirements and maintain accurate records.
  
- Strong communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
- Willingness to work hands-on in an early-stage startup.
  
  
Preference will be given to candidates with direct experience in spices, dry fruits, grains, agricultural commodities, and export-oriented food sourcing.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is suitable for someone who wants to build a new export operation rather than simply manage an established logistics department.
  
  
The selected candidate will initially work directly with the founder and take ownership of supplier discovery, product onboarding, compliance coordination, and logistics execution. The team will expand as HALBEX grows.
  
  
Application
  
  
Please apply with your CV and briefly describe:
  
  
1. The food or agricultural products you have sourced or handled.
  
2. The regions or supplier networks you know.
  
3. Your experience negotiating prices and evaluating suppliers.
  
4. Your export documentation and logistics experience.
  
5. Your availability to join a pre-launch startup.

**Company Description**
GMS Group – Loyalty Solutions is a multinational organization headquartered in Singapore, specializing in customized loyalty marketing solutions and related technology products for the hotel industry. Founded in 1999, the company has grown to a network of over 100 offices across 15 countries in Asia Pacific and employs more than 1,300 team members. With over two decades of experience, GMS designs, implements, and manages tailored loyalty programs that align with each hotel brand’s strategic goals. Its operations and marketing teams focus on driving incremental food and beverage member spend, giving hotels a powerful tool to optimize their F&B operations. The company offers a dynamic, performance-driven environment with opportunities to work closely with leading hotels in the region.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Executive role based in Kochi. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities with hotels, conducting lead generation activities, and building a strong pipeline of prospects for loyalty solutions. The Business Development Executive will conduct sales presentations and product demonstrations, prepare proposals, and negotiate commercial terms in coordination with internal stakeholders. Daily tasks include managing and nurturing client relationships, coordinating with marketing and operations teams to ensure successful program implementation, and monitoring performance metrics to support client success. The role also requires maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, providing regular sales reports, and staying informed about industry trends and competitor offerings.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation.
* Candidates should possess solid Business understanding and commercial acumen.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Candidates should possess effective Account Management and relationship-building skills.
* Experience in B2B sales, hospitality, or loyalty/marketing solutions is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, meet targets, and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.

title: Business Development Lead (MSP)
description:
We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Lead to drive new business growth in the Managed Service Provider (MSP) industry.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience in B2B sales, new customer acquisition, lead generation, and strategic partnership development within the managed IT services ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with MSPs and IT service providers, developing strategic partnerships, and driving revenue growth through managed services, recurring contracts, and channel partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & New Customer Acquisition

* Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers within the MSP and managed IT services market.
* Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve revenue and sales targets.
* Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and industry events.
* Build relationships with business owners, CEOs, CTOs, IT directors, and other key decision-makers.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification to proposal, negotiation, and deal closure.
* Identify new markets, industries, and opportunities for business expansion.

2. MSP & Channel Partner Development

* Build and maintain relationships with Managed Service Providers, IT service providers, system integrators, resellers, and technology partners.
* Identify partnership opportunities for outsourced IT services, subcontracting, co-managed IT, and white-label service delivery.
* Develop strategic partnerships to expand market reach and generate recurring revenue.
* Create partner engagement plans and work toward building long-term, revenue-generating relationships.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships through additional services and new customer segments.

3. Managed IT Services Sales

* Promote managed IT services, including IT support, helpdesk services, infrastructure management, network administration, cloud management, server management, and remote monitoring and management.
* Understand customer IT requirements and recommend suitable managed service solutions.
* Prepare business proposals, presentations, quotations, and commercial agreements.
* Work with technical and service delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions meet customer expectations.
* Identify opportunities for recurring service contracts, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling.

4. Lead Generation & Pipeline Management

* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and business partners.
* Conduct market research to identify target accounts and potential revenue opportunities.
* Qualify prospects based on business needs, budgets, decision-making authority, and service requirements.
* Maintain accurate sales activity, opportunity records, and forecasts in the CRM.
* Monitor sales performance and report progress against business development targets.

5. Account & Relationship Management

* Establish long-term relationships with customers and strategic partners.
* Maintain regular communication with key stakeholders to identify new business opportunities.
* Support customer retention and account expansion initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to service delivery.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience in B2B business development or sales, preferably within the MSP, managed IT services, or IT outsourcing industry.
* Proven track record in new customer acquisition, lead generation, and closing B2B deals.
* Strong understanding of MSP business models, managed services, recurring-revenue contracts, and IT outsourcing.
* Experience developing relationships with MSPs, IT service providers, system integrators, and enterprise customers.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve revenue targets.

**Preferred Skills**

* Existing network of MSPs, IT service providers, and channel partners.
* Experience with white-label managed services, subcontracting, and co-managed IT models.
* Understanding of recurring-revenue models, monthly recurring revenue (MRR), and annual recurring revenue (ARR).
* Experience in international B2B sales and developing new geographic markets, if applicable.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New business revenue generated.
* Number of new customers acquired.
* Qualified sales pipeline generated.
* Number of new MSP and channel partnerships established.
* Revenue generated through partner relationships.
* Sales conversion rate and deal closure performance.
* Growth in recurring managed services revenue.
* Customer retention and account expansion.

title: Head of Sales
description:
**About Vidyalai**

Vidyalai delivers 1-on-1 online tutoring for international curriculum - IB, IGCSE, A-Levels, AP, SAT and ACT and Australian boards. Our students are spread across the Gulf, Southeast Asia, Australia, US and Europe, and our buyers are parents making a considered, high-value decision about their child's academic outcome.

**The Role**

You own two things: turning enquiries into enrolled students who stay, and the team that does it. We have six counsellors today and we are looking for someone to take the function over properly, grow it, and make revenue predictable enough that we can plan against it.

You will be responsible not just for managing the existing sales team, but for building a predictable, scalable sales organization that consistently delivers revenue growth.

**What you will own:**

1. Net collected revenue, quarterly.
2. Track and improve conversions
3. The team - Hiring, ramping, coaching and curing, if required. You will be directly accountable for their performance.
4. Coaching from call recordings. We record every counselling call. We expect you to listen to a sample each week and give counsellors feedback on actual moments in their calls, with the timestamp.
5. CRM discipline. Stage definitions, hygiene, and forecasts that hold up.

**What we are looking for:**

* >5 years of strong sales experience, 1+ years of sales-team leadership experience
* Experience in Consultative, high-ticket, considered purchases. Education, healthcare, financial services, premium services or B2B.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels, conversion optimisation and CRM systems
* A coach, not just a manager. You can take a mediocre counsellor and make them good. You can point to people you've done it to.
* Data-native: You reason from conversion data and call evidence rather than from a playbook you brought with you.
* Willingness to be hands on: We are not looking for someone who wants to sit above the work. To deeply understand the work, we expect you to do it yourself also - calls, closing, objection handling etc.

**Please do not apply if you do not meet the above criteria.**

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala (on-site preferred)

**Compensation:**
Competitive package based on experience and role fit.

description:
**Summary**

**Location-**
**Kerala/Kochi**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coach the team to achieve sales, productivity and performance targets through strong in-field coaching, call planning and disciplined execution.
* Create and execute regional/territory business plans aligned to brand strategy (targeting, coverage, quarterly priorities, cycle plans) and review progress through regular business reviews.
* Drive high-quality, compliant HCP engagement (cardiologists/physicians) using evidence-led, value-based selling; strengthen disease/patient pathway understanding and objection handling.
* Use sales and prescription insights, analytics and market intelligence to optimize targeting, improve call effectiveness and implement timely corrective actions.
* Ensure brand plan execution and KPI governance (coverage, call quality, demand drivers, availability) and manage risks across competition, access and supply.
* Operate within company policies and ethical codes
* Partner with Marketing, Medical, Value & Access and Supply to deliver regional initiatives, resolve customer issues and improve patient access where applicable.
* Build team capability through structured coaching (joint work, role plays, feedback), onboarding, performance reviews and talent development/succession planning.
* Develop key accounts and KOLs across priority institutions/clinics to build advocacy and sustain demand

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  
Position: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
  
  
Company Name: Cochin Agro Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (CAMSOL)
  
Industry: Agriculture, Organic Fertilizers & Agricultural Inputs
  
Location: Kerala, India (Area/territory to be assigned)
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Department: Sales & Marketing
  
Reporting To: Sales Head / Managing Director
  
  
1. About CAMSOL
  
  
Cochin Agro Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (CAMSOL) is an agricultural solutions company specializing in organic fertilizers, soil conditioners, and agricultural consultancy services. We aim to support farmers with effective agricultural inputs while promoting sustainable farming practices.
  
  
2. Job Summary
  
  
CAMSOL is looking for a result-oriented and self-motivated Area Sales Manager to drive sales growth, expand dealer and distributor networks, and strengthen the company's presence across the assigned territory.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, managing customer relationships, conducting farmer outreach activities, and ensuring consistent market development for CAMSOL products.
  
  
3. Key Responsibilities
  
  
A. Sales & Business Development
  
  
- Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
  
- Identify and onboard new dealers, distributors, retailers, and institutional customers.
  
- Generate sales leads and convert them into business opportunities.
  
- Build strong relationships with existing customers to improve repeat purchases.
  
- Monitor sales performance and take corrective action to achieve targets.
  
- Explore opportunities through agricultural institutions, farmer groups, FPOs, and government-related procurement programs.
  
  
B. Dealer & Distributor Management
  
  
- Expand and manage the dealer and distributor network within the assigned territory.
  
- Conduct regular dealer visits to understand market requirements and support sales growth.
  
- Ensure product availability and effective stock movement across the distribution network.
  
- Follow up on outstanding payments and coordinate with the management team on collections.
  
- Maintain strong relationships with channel partners and resolve routine business concerns.
  
  
C. Farmer Engagement & Product Promotion
  
  
- Organize farmer meetings, product demonstrations, and agricultural awareness programs.
  
- Explain CAMSOL products, their applications, and recommended usage to farmers and dealers.
  
- Coordinate field demonstrations to generate product awareness and sales enquiries.
  
- Collect farmer feedback and communicate market requirements to management.
  
- Develop relationships with agricultural consultants, progressive farmers, and local agricultural networks.
  
  
D. Market Research & Reporting
  
  
- Monitor competitor activities, pricing, product offerings, and market trends.
  
- Identify new markets and opportunities for business expansion.
  
- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
  
- Maintain accurate records of customer visits, sales orders, collections, and dealer performance.
  
- Provide regular updates on territory performance and sales forecasts.
  
  
E. Team Coordination
  
  
- Coordinate with the marketing, logistics, and operations teams to ensure timely order fulfilment.
  
- Support the recruitment, training, and performance monitoring of sales representatives, where applicable.
  
- Ensure effective execution of company sales policies and promotional activities.
  
  
4. Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
  
- Candidates with a diploma in agriculture or relevant sales experience may also apply.
  
- Minimum 2–3 years of experience in agricultural sales, fertilizer sales, agrochemicals, or agricultural inputs preferred.
  
- Experience managing dealer and distributor networks will be an advantage.
  
- Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in agricultural sales may be considered for suitable candidates.
  
  
5. Required Skills
  
  
- Strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
  
- Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
  
- Knowledge of agricultural markets, fertilizers, and farming practices.
  
- Ability to plan field visits and manage an assigned territory independently.
  
- Target-oriented approach with a focus on revenue growth and collections.
  
- Basic computer skills, including MS Excel, email, and sales reporting.
  
- Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
  
- A valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence, as applicable, is preferred.
  
  
6. Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be evaluated based on:
  
  
- Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
  
- Number of new dealers and distributors activated.
  
- Revenue growth and repeat orders from existing customers.
  
- Collection of outstanding payments within agreed terms.
  
- Number of productive farmer meetings and product demonstrations.
  
- Growth in market coverage and customer acquisition.
  
- Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports.
  
  
7. Compensation & Benefits
  
  
- Salary based on experience, qualifications, and suitability.
  
- Performance-based incentives linked to sales achievements, subject to company policy.
  
- Travel allowance or reimbursement as per company policy.
  
- Opportunities for career growth within the organization.
  
  
8. How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates may submit their updated resume to CAMSOL.
  
  
Company: Cochin Agro Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (CAMSOL)
  
Email: hr.camsol@gmail.com
  
Contact: +91 62820 21210 / +91 62824 21210
  
Website/Social Media: CAMSOL Official
  
  
Join CAMSOL and contribute to sustainable agriculture by building stronger markets, empowering farmers, and expanding access to organic agricultural solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented
**Sales & Business Development Manager**

* Research competitors, market trends, and potential business segments.
* Develop sales strategies and outreach campaigns.

We value

.

* Focuses on converting opportunities into actual business.

* Client meetings and proposals completed.
* New clients acquired and deals closed.

Salary will be based on experience and capabilities. Performance-based incentives may be offered based on the company's compensation structure and agreed targets.

Interested candidates can share their CV along with a brief description of their sales experience, major achievements, and experience in acquiring new clients to hr@storibodcreatives.com

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.

* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

title: Account Coordinator-Senior Associate

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Competency**
Client Excellence – Account Excellence
  
  
**Role Type**
Senior Account Coordinator
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Associate at C&I team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management**

* Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
* In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
* Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
* Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams – focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
* To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
* Client Relationship Development
* Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
* Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
* Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
* Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
* Communication
* Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
* Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
* Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
* Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
* Facilitation of knowledge sharing

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
* Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Any Graduate
* 4-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
* Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc
* Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity & ability to build strong client relationships

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sales manager
description:
**Company Description**
WeePark is transforming parking and mobility management by making arrivals and departures seamless, organized, and stress-free. The company specializes in professional parking operations for corporate parks, hospitals, malls, residential communities, and commercial properties. WeePark currently manages over 100,000 parking spots and supports thousands of daily vehicle movements in Bengaluru, helping clients improve traffic flow, maximize space utilization, and elevate visitor experiences. Its services include valet operations, stack parking management, space optimization, shuttle services, car wash services, and additional parking solutions, with smart parking technology and other innovations on the way. WeePark is committed to delivering smarter, efficient, and customer-focused parking solutions so clients can focus on their core business.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Manager role based in Kochi. The Sales Manager will oversee the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to contract negotiation and closure, for WeePark’s parking and mobility solutions. The role involves identifying and engaging potential clients such as commercial properties, residential communities, hospitals, and corporate parks, while nurturing long-term relationships with existing customers. The Sales Manager will prepare proposals, conduct presentations, collaborate with operations and finance teams to ensure smooth service onboarding, and track sales performance against targets. Day-to-day responsibilities also include market research, pipeline management, regular reporting to leadership, and representing WeePark at meetings, site visits, and local industry events.

**Qualifications**

* Proven skills in B2B sales, account management, and client relationship building within services or mobility-related industries.
* Ability to conduct market research, identify new business opportunities, and manage a structured sales pipeline.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with proficiency in preparing proposals and business cases.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (operations, finance, customer service) to deliver integrated solutions.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and basic sales analytics to track performance and forecast revenue.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in parking, facilities management, real estate, mobility, or related sectors is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi, visit client locations regularly, and adapt to a dynamic, fast-growing environment.

title: sales manager
description:
**About the Role:**

Fleetgo Courier is seeking a highly driven and result-oriented Sales Manager with a strong

background in the courier, logistics, and supply chain industry. The ideal candidate should

have a proven track record in B2B sales, corporate client acquisition, revenue generation,

and sales team leadership.

The candidate must possess strong industry connections, the ability to develop new business

opportunities, and the commercial acumen to grow shipment volumes, expand Fleetgo's

customer base, and achieve sustainable revenue and profitability targets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and

annual revenue targets.

• Identify, approach, and acquire new corporate clients, SMEs, e-commerce

businesses, retailers, manufacturers, distributors, and other businesses requiring

courier and logistics services.

• Generate new business opportunities through direct sales, field visits, networking,

referrals, cold calling, and strategic partnerships.

• Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and consistently convert leads into active,

revenue-generating accounts.

• Develop and maintain long-term relationships with key accounts to increase

shipment volumes, customer retention, and repeat business.

• Identify opportunities to expand Fleetgo's services among existing customers and

increase revenue per account.

• Lead, manage, and motivate the sales team, establish individual targets, monitor

performance, and ensure achievement of assigned objectives.

• Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, contracts, and service-level agreements while

ensuring business profitability.

• Monitor competitor activities, market pricing, industry trends, and customer

requirements to identify growth opportunities.

• Coordinate with operations, customer service, and accounts teams to ensure smooth

onboarding, service quality, timely issue resolution, and customer satisfaction.

• Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, revenue growth, customer acquisition

costs, and account profitability.

• Prepare regular sales reports, business forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance

reviews for management.

• Ensure timely follow-up on quotations, proposals, client meetings, and pending

business opportunities.

• Develop strategies to recover inactive accounts, reduce customer attrition, and

improve customer retention.

• Travel as required to meet clients, develop new markets, and strengthen business

relationships.

**Requirements:**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of proven sales experience, preferably in the courier, express

delivery, logistics, or supply chain industry.

• Demonstrated experience in acquiring corporate clients and generating substantial

recurring business.

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets, preferably supported by

measurable revenue and business growth results.

• Experience in managing and developing a sales team, assigning targets, monitoring

performance, and driving accountability.

• Strong understanding of courier and logistics pricing, shipment volumes, delivery

networks, service commitments, and customer expectations.

• Existing industry contacts and the ability to convert professional networks into new

business opportunities.

• Experience in negotiating commercial contracts, pricing structures, credit terms, and

service agreements.

• Strong business development skills, including lead generation, prospecting, proposal

preparation, and closing deals.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management

skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, CRM systems, and sales reporting tools.

• Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development activities as

required.

title: Business Development & Client Retention Manager
description:
PropMarker is an AI-powered property intelligence and analytics platform helping UK property investors identify investment opportunities, analyse property deals, and make informed investment decisions using data-driven insights.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven
**Business Development & Client Retention Manager**
to join our office-based team at Infopark, Kochi.

This role focuses on building strong relationships with UK clients, converting free-trial users into paying subscribers, improving product adoption, and retaining existing customers. You will work closely with our UK and India teams to drive subscription growth, improve customer satisfaction, and contribute to the continued growth of PropMarker.

The ideal candidate will have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience, excellent English communication skills, and confidence in handling international client calls, product demonstrations, sales conversations, and customer retention activities.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Sales

• Conduct product demonstrations for prospective customers and explain PropMarker's features, benefits, and value proposition.

• Follow up with new sign-ups and free-trial users to encourage product adoption and convert prospects into paying subscribers.

• Identify sales opportunities and guide potential customers through the subscription journey.

• Understand customer requirements, address objections, and communicate the value of PropMarker effectively.

• Develop strong follow-up processes to improve lead conversion and subscription growth.

• Work towards individual and team targets for sales conversions and revenue growth.

2. Client Relationship Management & Retention

• Build and maintain strong relationships with UK clients through phone calls, WhatsApp, and email.

• Conduct regular retention calls with existing subscribers to understand their experience, gather feedback and identify potential cancellation risks.

• Proactively engage with inactive users and customers considering cancellation to understand their concerns and identify suitable solutions.

• Help customers understand and use PropMarker's features effectively to improve product adoption and satisfaction.

• Maintain consistent communication with clients throughout their customer journey.

• Identify opportunities to improve customer loyalty, subscription renewals, and long-term retention.

3. Customer Support & Communication

• Provide professional and timely support to UK customers through phone, WhatsApp, and email.

• Handle customer enquiries related to product features, subscriptions, and general platform usage.

• Resolve customer concerns efficiently and coordinate with the technical team when further assistance is required.

• Maintain professional communication standards and ensure timely follow-ups.

• Record customer interactions, enquiries, feedback and support issues accurately.

4. Reporting & Performance Management

• Track leads, product demonstrations, trial conversions, and subscription outcomes.

• Monitor customer engagement, retention performance, and cancellation trends.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and structured customer reports.

• Analyse reasons for trial drop-offs and subscription cancellations.

• Share customer insights and actionable recommendations with management to improve sales performance and customer experience.

• Contribute ideas to improve conversion rates, retention strategies, and subscription revenue.

5. Internal Team Coordination

• Work closely with the UK and India teams to coordinate client communication and business development activities.

• Share customer feedback and product improvement suggestions with the relevant internal teams.

• Collaborate with technical and management teams to support customer satisfaction and platform improvements.

• Contribute to the development of effective sales, follow-up, and customer retention processes.

Experience & Requirements

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in business development, inside sales, customer success, client relationship management, or customer retention.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to communicate professionally with UK clients.

• Previous experience working with UK or international clients is highly preferred.

• Proven experience in client-facing roles involving sales conversations, customer follow-ups, or relationship management.

• Experience conducting product demonstrations and converting leads into paying customers will be an advantage.

• Understanding of customer retention, subscription renewals, and cancellation prevention.

• Strong telephone communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple client interactions while maintaining accurate records and timely follow-ups.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and customer reporting tools.

• A proactive, organised and target-oriented approach to work.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with teams across India and the UK.

• Willingness to work from our Infopark, Kochi office, during working hours aligned with UK business requirements.

Key Performance Areas

Performance will be evaluated based on the following areas:

• Free-trial to paid-subscription conversion rates.

• Product demonstration effectiveness and sales performance.

• Customer retention and reduction in cancellations.

• Lead follow-up consistency and pipeline management.

• Product adoption and customer engagement.

• Customer satisfaction and response times.

• Accuracy of CRM records and reporting.

• Contribution to subscription growth and revenue targets.

Salary & Benefits

**Working Hours:**
Office-based shifts aligned with UK business requirements. Exact working hours will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Salary, incentives, and benefits will be confirmed based on the position, experience, and company policy.

Why Join PropMarker?

• Work with an AI-powered PropTech platform serving the UK property investment market.

• Collaborate with teams across India and the UK.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**About Esperer Motors**

Esperer Motors is a premium automotive aftermarket company headquartered in Kochi, Kerala. Esperer Motors designs and develops its own body kits, spoilers, side skirts, splitters, diffusers and interior accessories for popular Indian and imported cars.

We are also authorised partners for global performance brands including Brembo, Eibach, EBC, BMC, H&R, DGR, MTS Technik, Forge, Blüsteine and Brake Kraft, and sell through retail, a tiered dealer network and export markets.

**Role Summary**

We are hiring a Sales Executive to grow sales of Esperer Motors products through face-to-face selling. You will visit car accessory shops, detailing studios, body shops, workshops, dealerships and car clubs to demonstrate Esperer Motors body kits, spoilers, skirts and interior accessories, win new dealers and installers, and close orders.

This is a target-driven, on-the-ground role for someone who loves cars, enjoys meeting people and can turn a product demo into a sale.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Field sales & product promotion**

•      Meet customers, shop owners and installers face to face to present and demonstrate Esperer Motors body kits, spoilers, side skirts, splitters and interior accessories

•      Explain fitment, materials, finish and value versus competing products; carry samples, catalogues and fitment photos

•      Generate and close orders from retail customers, accessory shops, detailing studios and body shops

•      Follow up on leads from the website, Instagram, WhatsApp and IndiaMART with in-person visits

**Dealer & installer network development**

•      Identify, onboard and grow new dealers and Authorised Installers in the assigned territory

•      Manage existing dealer accounts: stock levels, display, reorders, schemes and payment follow-up

•      Train dealer and workshop staff on Esperer Motors products, fitment and selling points

•      Coordinate with the installation team to ensure smooth fitment and customer satisfaction

**Events & brand activation**

•      Represent Esperer Motors at auto expos, car meets, club drives and in-store activations

•      Build relationships with car clubs, influencers and modification enthusiasts in the region

**Customer relationships & reporting**

•      Build long-term relationships with customers and dealers for repeat orders and referrals

•      Handle after-sales queries and coordinate quick resolution with the service team

•      Update visits, leads and orders in the CRM and submit a weekly sales report

•      Share competitor pricing, new products and customer feedback from the market with the team

**Targets & KPIs**

1. Monthly Sales: Achieve the monthly revenue target for Esperer Motors products (₹).

2. Field Visits: Complete the required number of customer and dealer visits per week.

3. New Dealers & Installers: Onboard new dealer and installer accounts every month.

4. Lead Conversion: Improve the percentage of leads and field visits converted into orders.

5. Collections: Ensure timely collection of payments against outstanding amounts.

6. Reporting: Update the CRM daily and submit weekly reports on time.

Note: Exact numeric targets will be set by the Business Development Manager (BDM) at the time of joining and reviewed quarterly.

**Required skills & qualification**

•      1–4 years of field sales experience, ideally in automotive accessories, car care, tyres or spare parts

•      Confident face-to-face communicator with strong presentation, negotiation and closing skills

•      Genuine interest in cars and modifications; able to talk fitment and styling with enthusiasts

•      Comfortable with targets, daily travel and a high volume of visits

•      Basic computer skills: Excel / Google Sheets, CRM and WhatsApp Business

•      Ability to track numbers and present simple sales reports

•      Fluent Malayalam and English; Tamil, Kannada or Hindi is a plus

•      Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence

**Preferred / nice to have**

•      Existing network of accessory shops, body shops, detailing studios or car dealerships in Kerala

•      Knowledge of body kit materials (ABS, PP, FRP, carbon fibre) and installation basics

•      Experience with B2B dealer sales and distributor schemes

•      Active presence in car clubs or the automotive enthusiast community

•      Four-wheeler driving licence

**What we offer**

•      Salary of ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month plus performance incentives

•      Travel and fuel allowance for field visits

•      Product and fitment training on Esperer Motors products and partner brands

•      Clear growth path to Senior Sales Executive and Area Sales Manager

•      The chance to build a home-grown performance brand alongside world-class names

**How to apply**

Send your CV to
**hr@esperermotors.com**
with the subject line "Sales Executive – Esperer Motors".

Mention your current territory and the automotive businesses you already work with.

Open question: incentive structure and exact territory to be confirmed before posting.

A strategic sales leader with a strong track record in the study abroad industry, capable of driving revenue growth, building accountable teams, expanding business opportunities, and achieving sustainable organisational growth.
