title: Account Manager-Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Account Manager in GDS is primarily responsible to work closely with UK Account Manager and account leadership to support the planning and implementation of the account activation strategy. The AM will closely work with the Global Client Service Partner (GCSP) and Client Executive (CE) to drive global account activation; drive account management excellence; sales and program management; and account communications & administration. He / She ensures that all locations and Service Lines (SL) of the firm are actively engaged around our global accounts and that we deliver Exceptional Client Service (ECS) in all internal and external encounters. This role will be aligned to GCSP / CE / account team and will be based in a non-client proximate location
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management:**

* Implement global Account Activation strategy, methodology and processes at Account level
* Co-develop account strategy working with account leadership and drive global execution of account plan
* Support account team in driving service line planning activity and account integration
* Responsible to conduct Account Maturity Assessments and supports in preparation of Account Acceleration sessions
* Prepare the global account meeting materials and facilitate account team meetings
* Responsible for follow-up on account actions by tracking progress against deadlines and driving activity
* Understand both the client’s business agenda and EY services to enable leveraging the global EY network to connect our clients to the right people
* Develop and manage the account onboarding process and appropriate materials
* Drive the Assessment of Service Quality (ASQ) process: Collate the ASQ feedbacks in Matrix and drive action after interviews and year-end follow-up
* Act as a project manager for Account specific initiatives/projects
* Review of account financials to provide awareness to account leadership on drivers of account performance
* Monitoring of operational metrics important to team each month and working with account partners or service line leaders on troubleshooting issues
* Support special projects as needed that require financial data/analysis

**Sales and Program Management:**

* Manage the annual global revenue planning process with the G360 Business Development Leader (BDL) and GCSP
* Own and manage the Client Relationship Management (CRM) process
* Co-develop the account relationship strategy, including management of the global relationship map
* Manage the account pipeline process and drive discipline across global team
* Coordinate the pursuit process for opportunities, working closely with key partners
* Execute win/loss debriefs
* Identify EY thought leadership and insights to be shared with the client
* Creation and maintenance of account marketing materials (i.e. team brochure discussion relationship history, or Value Scorecard or procurement showcase doc)
* Develop and maintain relationship of Account Managers, Market Segment Managers, to understand latest market- place, alliance, and solution activity within sector or like accounts

**Information and Knowledge Management**

* Be strategic to collaborate and partner with enabling functions of EY in supporting the account (where applicable):

+ Offshore Account Enablement team in India – pipeline management, financial analysis, sales cycle support, client research, Account plan management
+ EY Knowledge – Account Analysis, Quarterly earnings call summaries, travel packs on client’s business, competitive landscape
+ Finance – Any financial needs of the account
+ Brand, Marketing and Communications – Account specific events, targeted thought leadership
+ Administrative Support – Meeting scheduling and any other administrative tasks
+ Global Sector/Industry – Identify market trends and EY insights
+ Service lines and geographies - Create process flows required for the team to capture information across account

* Build and manage a repository of team information (i.e. MSA, Rate Card, SOW templates, onboarding documents, team process documents, qualifications, etc) and guide team on how to access and use
* Develop and maintain relationships with the account teams to understand best practices for team information and knowledge management

**Marketing Management**

* Development and execution of account marketing plan to include
* Distribution of thought leadership and/or event invites to relationships targets

+ Alumni relations
+ Support creation and distribution of team communications (i.e. team/client newsletter, WIN announcements)

* Develop and maintain relationships with account teams to understand best practices for marketing activities

**Communications and Administration**

* Serves as subject matter expert for all information related to the account
* Leverage EY resources to support the account
* In consultation with account leadership manages Account specific events, identifies and leverages targeted thought leadership
* Global Sector/Industry - Identify market trends and EY insights to take to account
* Serve as the knowledge steward of the account and with the assistance of EY Knowledge, connect global team to EY tools and client business issues

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* May be required to make decisions on behalf of Partners to expedite results
* Influences without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Project Management – experience building and managing project plans
* Presentation/Analysis – experience building .ppt presentations or discussion documents to explain a strategy, process, or relationship history; experience using .xls to analyze data for purpose of generating insights on trends within data set
* Professional maturity to confidently interact with Account Partners. Demonstrate a level of assertiveness, authority while communicating with the Senior Stakeholders and ability to articulate the view points in a succinct manner
* Communication – Demonstrate effective communication at levels of the organization. Understand the nuances, ability to listen effectively, have a global mindset and operate effectively across borders inclusively
* Consultative – demonstrated ability to approach problems and/or projects through effective question/answer techniques to identify needs/issues/desired outcomes and propose solutions to meet needs/issues/desired outcomes
* Emotional Intelligence – demonstrated understanding of different working/personality styles and appreciation of need to flex approach and message to effectively engage
* Networking – demonstrated ability to create networks within a company and use the networks to navigate across an organization for purpose of getting information to answer questions that arise across account
* Ambiguity – personality that is conducive to highly unstructured environments and situations
* Entrepreneur/Proactive behaviors – desire to make the role their own and to create opportunity areas to involve themselves in day-to-day operations

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Postgraduate in business management – preferably an MBA
* 7-8 years working in a professional services firm delivering operational enablement service to teams in different geographies plus previous sales, marketing, business development experience would be preferable

**Certification Requirements**

* Expected to remain current on relevant EY training and curriculum (e.g., Account Management Framework (AMF), Lead Badges, among others

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc
* Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity & ability to build strong client relationships

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Federal Proposal Writer
description:
Job Title

**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager – GSA MAS**

Job Type

Full-Time | Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced
**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager**
with strong knowledge of the
**U.S. federal contracting environment**
, particularly
**GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
opportunities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting the full federal business development lifecycle, including
**opportunity identification, capture strategy, solicitation analysis, proposal development, compliance, pricing coordination, and submission**
.

The candidate will work closely with business development, recruiting, delivery, contracts, pricing, and leadership teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals for federal government opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**Federal Capture Management**

* Identify and evaluate federal contracting opportunities aligned with company capabilities and growth objectives.
* Support the capture lifecycle from
  **early opportunity identification through proposal submission and award**
  .
* Develop and maintain
  **capture plans, opportunity assessments, win strategies, call plans, and action plans**
  .
* Analyze agency requirements, procurement history, incumbent information, competition, contract vehicles, and anticipated acquisition strategies.
* Track opportunities through
  **SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, agency procurement forecasts, and other federal procurement sources**
  .
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to establish bid/no-bid recommendations based on documented opportunity factors.

**Proposal Development & Writing**

* Lead or support the development of federal government proposals, RFIs, Sources Sought responses, RFQs, RFP responses, capability statements, and task-order proposals.
* Develop persuasive content for
  **Technical, Management, Staffing, Past Performance, Corporate Experience, and Executive Summary**
  sections.
* Translate technical and operational information from SMEs into clear, compliant, evaluator-focused proposal content.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices, annotated outlines, storyboards, and content plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly address
  **Section L instructions and Section M evaluation criteria**
  , where applicable.
* Coordinate proposal inputs from SMEs, recruiting, operations, finance, contracts, and leadership.
* Edit and quality-check proposal content for clarity, consistency, grammar, formatting, and compliance.

**GSA MAS Experience**

* Support proposal and contract activities associated with the
  **GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
  .
* Demonstrate familiarity with the GSA MAS solicitation structure, SINs, labor categories, pricing requirements, and applicable proposal documentation.
* Assist with identifying appropriate
  **Special Item Numbers (SINs)**
  based on company capabilities.
* Support preparation and maintenance of GSA MAS-related documentation, including labor category descriptions, qualifications, pricing information, and supporting narratives.
* Understand the importance of maintaining consistency between the company's capabilities, labor categories, pricing, and federal proposal submissions.
* Support responses to GSA/eBuy RFQs and task-order opportunities under applicable contract vehicles.

**Compliance & Proposal Management**

* Develop and maintain detailed
  **compliance matrices**
  mapping solicitation requirements to proposal responses.
* Track solicitation amendments, questions and answers, deadlines, deliverables, and proposal responsibilities.
* Conduct color-team reviews such as
  **Pink Team, Red Team, and Gold Team**
  reviews as appropriate.
* Identify proposal gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and missing solicitation requirements before submission.
* Maintain proposal libraries, reusable content, past-performance information, resumes, corporate qualifications, and relevant project descriptions.

**Business Development & Capture Support**

* Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to strengthen federal market positioning.
* Research federal agencies, buying patterns, competitors, incumbents, and upcoming procurements.
* Assist with development of
  **capability statements, one-pagers, presentations, white papers, and sources-sought responses**
  .
* Support teaming and subcontractor research when required.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and capture information within CRM or pipeline-management systems.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience**
  in federal proposal writing, capture management, business development, or federal contracting.
* Demonstrated experience with
  **U.S. federal government proposals and solicitations**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **GSA MAS / GSA eBuy**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of federal solicitation terminology, including
  **RFI, Sources Sought, RFQ, RFP, SOW, PWS, SOO, L/M sections, evaluation criteria, and compliance matrices**
  .
* Experience researching opportunities through
  **SAM.gov**
  and other federal procurement resources.
* Strong proposal writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills.
* Experience working with technical SMEs and translating technical information into proposal-ready content.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and competing deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify compliance gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting
  **GSA MAS SINs and eBuy opportunities**
  .
* Experience with
  **IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, BOA, and task-order competitions**
  .
* Knowledge of federal acquisition processes and
  **FAR/DFARS**
  requirements.
* Experience with federal staffing, IT services, professional services, or technology contracts.
* Experience supporting
  **8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, or other small-business federal contracting programs**
  .
* Proposal certification such as
  **APMP**
  is a plus.
* Experience with proposal management tools, CRM systems, or platforms such as
  **GovWin, Deltek, Salesforce, Loopio, Responsive, or similar systems**
  .

Core Competencies

* Federal Proposal Writing
* Capture Management
* GSA MAS
* GSA eBuy
* Federal Business Development
* SME Coordination
* Proposal Reviews
* FAR/DFARS Awareness
* SAM.gov Research
* Task-Order Proposal Development

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should understand
**how to interpret the solicitation once released, and how to turn that strategy into a compliant and persuasive proposal**
.

Particular value will be placed on candidates who have
**personally supported GSA MAS activities and GSA eBuy opportunities**
, rather than candidates whose experience is limited to commercial proposals.

title: Senior Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Back to Careers

**Senior Lead Generation Specialist**

This role is fundamentally about starting conversations. You will be calling business owners, senior managers and decision-makers who may not know us, may not be expecting our call, and may initially have little reason to speak with us. Your job is to change that. We are looking for someone who enjoys meeting new people, is naturally curious about them and their businesses, and can turn a cold call into an engaging conversation.

Posted: Oct 09, 2026

extroverted, highly articulate and people-oriented professional

enjoys meeting new people

cold call into an engaging conversation

**What You Will Do**

* Make a high volume of outbound calls to prospective customers and decision-makers.
* Start conversations confidently with people who have never heard of us.
* Research prospects and understand their business before making the call.
* Introduce our IT products and services in a natural, conversational way.
* Engage prospects in
  **interesting two-way conversations**
  , rather than simply delivering a sales pitch.
* Ask thoughtful questions and genuinely listen to the answers.
* Understand the prospect's business, challenges and current way of working.
* Build trust and credibility during the first conversation.
* Identify genuine opportunities and schedule qualified meetings for the sales team.
* Follow up consistently through calls, email and LinkedIn.
* Maintain accurate records of conversations and follow-ups in the CRM.
* Experiment with different approaches, messaging and opening lines to improve results.

**The Person We Are Looking For**

**You MUST be a people person.**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is
  **naturally extroverted and highly comfortable around people**
  .
* **Loves talking to people**
  and genuinely enjoys having conversations with strangers.
* Can pick up the phone and confidently call someone they have never spoken to before.
* Has the ability to make people feel comfortable within the first few minutes of a conversation.
* Is highly articulate and can express ideas clearly and confidently.
* Can keep a conversation going rather than asking a few scripted questions and ending the call.
* Is curious about people, businesses and how they operate.
* Can listen carefully and respond intelligently to what the other person says.
* Can speak confidently with senior executives, business owners and decision-makers.
* Can build
  **trust and confidence quickly**
  without being overly aggressive or "salesy."
* Is comfortable thinking on their feet when a prospect takes the conversation in an unexpected direction.
* **Does not get discouraged by rejection.**
* Can hear "No," "Not interested" or "Send me an email" repeatedly and still enthusiastically make the next call.
* Gets energy from conversations rather than feeling drained by them.

**Communication Is Critical**

We are looking for
**exceptionally strong verbal communication**
, not merely acceptable English.

You should be able to:

* Speak fluently and confidently.
* Explain an idea clearly without overcomplicating it.
* Have a natural business conversation rather than sound like you are reading a script.
* Adjust your communication style depending on who you are speaking with.
* Ask good questions and listen for what the prospect is actually saying.
* Handle objections without becoming defensive.
* Create enough curiosity for the prospect to want to continue the conversation.

**Your ability to communicate, connect and build rapport will matter more than your ability to deliver a perfectly memorised pitch.**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **2–3 years of experience in B2B lead generation, preferably for IT products, SaaS, software or IT services.**
* Proven experience with outbound calling and cold lead generation.
* Strong spoken English and professional communication skills.
* Experience speaking with business owners, CXOs, senior managers or department heads is preferred.
* Experience with CRM systems and lead-generation tools is preferred.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar prospecting tools is an advantage.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**Who We Are**

Proficio Therapy Services is a mission driven therapy organization dedicated to improving the lives of children and families. We provide high quality ABA Therapy, Speech Therapy, and Occupational Therapy through our family of licensed clinical entities:

* **AGES Learning Solutions LLC**

  ABA Therapy
* **Proficio Speech Therapy Group Inc**

  Speech Therapy
* **Childs Play Therapy Services PC**

  – Occupational Therapy

Today, we operate 11 clinics across the United States, supported by more than 250 clinicians.

We are actively expanding into additional cities throughout California and Utah, with international growth underway in India and the Middle East.

Our teams are backed by strong clinical leadership, reliable operational systems, and a culture built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration. Whether you’re starting your career or stepping into leadership, you’ll find opportunities to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact every day.

At Proficio, your work truly matters and so does your growth. Join us as we continue building a unified, global therapy organization dedicated to empowering children and families.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven Business Development Executive – US Market to support the growth and expansion of Proficio Therapy Services in the United States.

The primary focus of this role will be to identify, develop, and generate new business and referral opportunities through structured outbound outreach, relationship building, market research, and consistent follow-up. The Business Development Executive will be responsible for connecting with Pediatricians, Pediatric Clinics, Diagnostic Centers, Preschools, Schools, Child Development Centers, Healthcare Providers, Community Organizations, and other relevant referral sources across our target markets in the US.

The role requires an individual who is comfortable with high-volume outbound calling and prospecting while also being capable of building long-term professional relationships with healthcare providers, educators, administrators, and other decision-makers.

The successful candidate will be expected to develop a strong understanding of Proficio’s therapy services, identify organizations and professionals who can become potential referral or business partners, generate qualified leads, secure meetings, and support the conversion of these opportunities into sustainable referral relationships.

This is a target-driven position and requires strong ownership of the business development pipeline, from initial prospect identification through outreach, qualification, follow-up, and handover of qualified opportunities

**Roles and Responsibilities**
**Business Development & Lead Generation**

* Identify and generate qualified business leads within designated US markets through outbound calls, emails, professional networking, online research, and other targeted outreach activities.
* Conduct consistent outreach to Pediatricians, Pediatric Clinics, Diagnostic Centers, Preschools, Schools, Child Development Centers, Healthcare Organizations, and other potential referral partners.
* Research assigned markets and build a comprehensive database of prospective referral sources and business partners.
* Identify key decision-makers and establish contact with individuals responsible for referrals, partnerships, care coordination, student services, special education, or related functions.
* Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective referral partners and business opportunities.
* Proactively identify new channels and organizations that could generate referrals for Proficio's services.

**Outbound Calling & Prospect Engagement**

* Conduct regular outbound and cold-calling campaigns targeting prospective referral sources.
* Confidently introduce Proficio Therapy Services and communicate our service offerings and value proposition.
* Engage prospective partners in meaningful conversations to understand their patient, student, or community needs.
* Identify opportunities where Proficio's services could support children and families requiring therapy services.
* Navigate gatekeepers effectively and establish contact with relevant decision-makers.
* Handle initial questions and objections professionally and appropriately.
* Follow up consistently with prospective partners through calls, emails, and other approved communication channels.
* Schedule meetings, presentations, or introductory discussions with qualified prospects for the appropriate internal leadership or clinical teams.

**Referral Relationship Development**

* Develop professional relationships with potential referral sources and maintain regular communication with them.
* Build awareness of Proficio's services among healthcare professionals, educational institutions, and community organizations.
* Maintain engagement with existing and prospective referral partners to strengthen relationships and identify additional opportunities.
* Support initiatives aimed at increasing referrals and improving Proficio's visibility within target communities.
* Identify opportunities for long-term partnerships rather than focusing solely on one-time referrals.

**Market Research & Territory Development**

* Conduct ongoing research on assigned US markets to identify new business opportunities, referral sources, competitors, and market trends.
* Develop a strong understanding of the US pediatric healthcare, behavioral health, therapy, and education ecosystem.
* Identify underserved geographic areas or potential markets where demand for pediatric therapy services may exist.
* Maintain updated information on potential referral organizations and decision-makers.
* Provide feedback to management regarding market conditions, referral trends, competitor activity, and opportunities identified through outreach.
* Recommend new outreach strategies, target segments, and potential partnership opportunities based on market findings.

**Lead Qualification & Pipeline Management**

* Qualify prospects based on defined criteria before progressing them through the business development pipeline.
* Maintain clear visibility of all prospects at different stages of the pipeline.
* Ensure timely and structured follow-up of all open leads and opportunities.
* Prioritize high-potential referral sources and opportunities based on business needs.
* Work toward converting initial conversations into qualified meetings, referral relationships, and business opportunities.
* Ensure qualified opportunities are appropriately handed over to the relevant internal team for further discussion or conversion.

**CRM, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all business development activities in the designated CRM or tracking system.
* Document calls, emails, contacts, follow-ups, meetings, referral opportunities, and outcomes.
* Maintain accurate prospect and decision-maker contact information.
* Ensure all follow-up activities are completed within agreed timelines.
* Prepare regular reports covering outreach volume, leads generated, meetings scheduled, opportunities created, referral sources developed, and conversions.
* Track individual performance against established weekly, monthly, and quarterly targets.
* Use data and results to identify areas requiring improvement and modify outreach strategies accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with US Operations, Clinical, Intake, Marketing, and other relevant teams to support business development initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure that prospective partners receive accurate information about services, locations, availability, and referral processes.
* Facilitate smooth handover of qualified leads and business opportunities to the appropriate internal teams.
* Share market feedback and referral-source insights that could help improve service positioning and business development strategies.
* Participate in regular business development meetings and provide updates on pipeline progress, challenges, and opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Postgraduate (PG) qualification in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in business development, sales, lead generation, inside sales, or a similar role.
* Prior experience in US market business development or outbound calling is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with healthcare, pediatric, education, childcare, or related sectors will be an added advantage.
* Strong experience in cold calling, lead generation, and prospect engagement.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, lead tracking tools, and structured sales or business development processes is desirable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently with healthcare professionals and business decision-makers.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with US-based teams.
* Willingness to travel to the US once a year for business requirements.

**Work Schedule**

* Full-Time – Work From Office (Kochi)
* Night Shift to support US operations and business hours.
* Ability to collaborate with US-based teams and accommodate operational requirements as needed.
* Willingness to travel to the US once a year for up to 20 days.

**Compensation**

* Salary: ₹ 70,000- 80,000 per month
* Quarterly Performance Incentives
* Annual opportunity to travel to the US for business purposes, up to 20 days.
* Opportunity to work closely with US-based teams and develop international business relationships.

title: Senior Academic Counselor
description:
**Job Title: Senior Academic Counselor** 




**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a high\-performing Senior Academic Counselor to drive our enrollment funnel and mentor our junior team. This is a pivotal, hybrid role requiring a combination of advanced consultative sales mastery (Deep Counseling) and leadership capabilities (Coaching, QA, and Funnel Ownership). You will handle complex, high\-stakes enrollments, enforce strict operational boundaries, and provide data\-driven insights to the Hub Manager/Founder.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Honest Intake \& Deep Counseling:**
* **The 45\-Minute Session:** 
 Run comprehensive counseling sessions at the center (ideally with a parent present). Explain the course architecture and present the reality of the program honestly, explicitly including the demanding aspects that put people off.
* **Qualify \& Firmly Disqualify:** 
 Record exactly why a lead is not a fit. Turn away prospects who require classroom teaching or cannot commit to six days a week—kindly, but firmly.
* **Protect the Schedule:** 
 Enforce strict intake rules. Cohorts open every Monday. Never promise a start date that is not a Monday, a gate that is not a Thursday or Friday, or a guaranteed job.
* **Closing \& Financial Administration:**
* **Secure Enrollments:** 
 Walk students through the enrollment agreement clause by clause. Secure guardian signatures for students under 18 and guardian contact details for those under 21\.
* **Collection \& Handoff:** 
 Collect and receipt the ₹10,000 registration fee. Collect the student's GitHub username and complete the hand\-off to the Operations Manager for account creation before the Monday start.
* **Caseload Escalation \& Retention:**
* **Fee Ledger Management:** 
 Remind students at 7 days overdue and escalate at 21 days. Enforce the strict consequence: they may finish their current module but cannot start the next until cleared. Never threaten portal access or gate access over money.
* **Pauses, Exits \& Refunds:** 
 Process pause requests within the strict 8\-week cap. When a student exits, record the date immediately, calmly and accurately explain the refund band, and pass the refund processing to the Operations Manager.
* **Post\-Completion:** 
 Enter the placement record when a student secures a job and conduct the six\-month "how did it go" follow\-up call.
* **Team Leadership, QA \& Reporting:**
* Coach and mentor Junior Counselors, standardizing sales scripts and enforcing CRM hygiene.
* Take ownership of the aggregate enquiry\-to\-enrollment funnel, monitor KPIs, and report bottlenecks to leadership.
* Handle high\-priority escalations, student disputes, and third\-strike interventions.



**What We Are Looking For:** 



* **Proven Track Record:** 
 At least 3\-5 years of success in high\-ticket academic counseling, educational sales, or a similar consultative admissions environment.
* **Coaching Instinct:** 
 Demonstrated experience in training, QA, or mentoring sales teams.
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Comfortable using CRM data and analytics to track performance and enforce operational rules.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of current academic trends, career pathways, and curriculum structures.
* **Exceptional Communication:** 
 Mastery of direct, uncompromising counseling techniques and executive\-level reporting.



**Position Details:** 



* **Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Format:** 
 On\-site

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager – Digital Marketing
 
  





 📍
 **Kochi \| Full\-time \| ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 \+ Monthly Incentives**




  




 What we're looking forMust have
 * 2–4 years of experience in a digital marketing agency, marketing agency or advertising services environment
* A good understanding of digital marketing fundamentals
* Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Malayalam
* Ability to understand a client's business and marketing requirements
* Ability to independently research markets, competitors and opportunities
* Ability to create structured proposals, marketing plans and presentations
* Strong ownership of the sales process
* Comfortable speaking with business owners, founders and senior decision\-makers
* Willingness to travel for client meetings when required


 You don't need to be a digital marketing expert.
 
 You should understand the basics of Digital Marketing Strategy and Performance Marketing.
 



 You don't need to be an expert in everything. Our friendly team can teach you the specifics.
 



 What matters more is your ability to understand the bigger picture and connect marketing activities to business objectives.
 



  





  




 About Equal Stories
 
  





 Equal Stories is a digital\-first marketing agency built around one simple belief:
 



**Collaboration is the future.** 




  





 We work with businesses to solve marketing and growth problems through
 **marketing strategy, performance marketing, content creation and marketing automation systems.** 




  





 We’re looking for a
 **Business Development Manager** 
 to join our team in Kochi.
 



  





 This isn't a conventional sales role. Your job is
 **not simply to make calls and chase cold leads.** 




 We’re looking for someone who understands
 **marketing, business and clients** 
 — someone who can take a business problem, identify the opportunity, work with our strategy, campaigns and creative teams, and turn it into a compelling marketing proposal.
 



 And then, importantly,
 **take that opportunity all the way to closing.**



 What will you be doing?
   

 🔍 Understand the Client \& Find the Opportunity
 
 Work with prospects to understand their business, objectives and current marketing activities, and identify how Equal Stories can help them grow.
 



 You should be comfortable doing independent research and identifying
 **where we can create real value for the prospect.**



 💡 Build Marketing Plans \& Proposals
 
 This is a key part of the role.
 



 You’ll work closely with
 **the founders** 
 , along with our Campaigns and Creative teams, to develop marketing solutions for prospects.
 



 You’ll conduct market and competitor research, develop marketing approaches, gather inputs from our internal teams, and turn them into structured
 **marketing plans, proposals and pitch decks** 
 that genuinely add value to the client.
 



 You don't need to know everything on day one.
 



 What matters is that you can
 **understand a marketing problem, ask the right questions, connect the dots and turn ideas into a clear proposal.**



 🤝 Manage the Sales Process
 
 We already have a strong ecosystem of leads coming through our networks, referrals and marketing activities.
 



 You’ll take ownership of these opportunities from the initial conversation through to closure.
 



 For larger and strategic opportunities, you’ll work closely with the founders to develop the proposal, pitch and commercial approach and take the opportunity forward together.
 



 For smaller opportunities, you should be capable of independently managing the complete process:
 



**Lead → Discovery → Proposal → Presentation → Negotiation → Closing → Handover to Client Servicing**



 🎤 Present \& Pitch
 
  





 You should be comfortable sitting across the table from a business owner or marketing head and explaining:
 



**“This is what we understand about your business, this is the opportunity we see, and this is how we can help.”** 




 You’ll independently present proposals for smaller clients and progressively take ownership of larger pitches as you grow into the role.
   




 🚀 Build New Opportunities
 
 A significant part of your pipeline will come through our existing network, referrals and inbound marketing. At the same time, we expect you to identify relevant businesses and create opportunities independently.
 



 You should be naturally curious about businesses, brands and markets — and able to spot where a company may have a marketing or growth opportunity that Equal Stories can help solve
 



  





  




 What you can expect at Equal Stories
 
  




 👊 Work directly with the founders
 
  





 You'll work closely with
 **the founders — two 90s kids with 14\+ years of experience in the industry.** 




 You'll get direct exposure to how we approach clients, build strategies, price projects, pitch businesses and close deals.
 



  




 🧑‍💻 A vibrant team
 
 You'll be working with a young, energetic team of Gen Zs.
 



 If you're one of them, you'll probably fit right in.
 



 If you're not, don't worry —
 **you can always hang out with the founders. 😄** 




  




 🤝 A strong pipeline to work with
 
 You won't be starting from zero.
 



 Between our founder network, referrals, BNI and inbound marketing campaigns, we already have a steady flow of opportunities.
 



 Most of our clients come through
 **referrals and relationships** 
 — so you're not walking into a room and trying to convince strangers that we exist.
 



 More often,
 **we're being invited in because someone believes we can solve a problem.** 




 Your job is to
 **understand those opportunities, build the right solution and convert them into clients.** 




  




 📚 Learn marketing while doing business development
 
 You'll work alongside our
 **Campaigns, Creative, Client Servicing and Strategy teams** 
 , giving you hands\-on exposure to how real marketing strategies are built and executed.
 



  




 💰 Incentives for ownership
 
 Along with the fixed salary, we offer
 **generous monthly incentives based on successful closures.** 




 There is also additional incentive potential for
 **independently identifying and closing new business opportunities.** 




  





  




 Compensation \& Location
 
  





**Salary:** 
 ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month
 



**Incentives:** 
 Monthly incentives based on closures \+ additional incentives for independently sourced business
 



**Location:** 
 Kochi
 



**Work model:** 
 Office\-based
 



**Working hours:** 
 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday
 



**Travel:** 
 Willingness to travel for client meetings is required
 



  





  




 One important thing before you apply
 
  





**This is not a conventional sales role.** 




 If your experience is primarily in selling unrelated products or services and you don't have a connection to marketing, advertising or digital marketing, this role probably isn't for you.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who already understands the language of marketing and wants to take the next step into
 **marketing\-led business development and client strategy.** 




  





 If you like
 **business, marketing, people, strategy and closing deals** 
 , we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth & Revenue Lead (AI Tech)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Opportunity You already know how to sell technology. You know how to open a conversation, navigate objections, and close deals. But you might be missing two things: a product that genuinely disrupts its category, and a compensation structure where your effort compounds instead of resetting to zero every quarter.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing, highly agile deeptech company looking for a seasoned sales professional to build and scale our outbound sales function. You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will be helping to write it.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 Tuck is an AI\-powered virtual try\-on platform for global e\-commerce apparel brands. We solve a fundamental problem: shoppers hesitate to buy when they can't visualize the fit, leading to abandoned carts and high return rates. Tuck allows shoppers to see garments on their own photos, matched perfectly with brand size charts, directly driving up merchant conversions.
 



  





 Unlike competitors using off\-the\-shelf AI wrappers, we built a proprietary pipeline that delivers unmatched realism on actual retail catalogs. Our leadership team has a proven track record of building category\-defining technology, having previously built India’s first cashierless store technology which was successfully acquired by Amazon.
 



  





 The Role Your focus will be entirely on selling Tuck to founders and e\-commerce heads of D2C fashion brands globally. You will open conversations, diagnose their store's bottlenecks, demonstrate our solution using their own product catalogs, and close deals.
 



*Crucially: You won’t spend your days hunting for leads.* 
 We provide a researched, qualified pipeline. Your job is to drive the conversation. You will also have a seat at the table to shape our pitch, target segments, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 



  





**The Compensation** 



* **Fixed Base:** 
 ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 monthly, commensurate with experience.
* **Closing Incentives:** 
 Uncapped per\-client bonuses scaled to the plan they choose.
* **Recurring Commission:** 
 5% of your client's monthly subscription fee for their first 12 months. Your income grows with your book of business.
* **Target Earnings:** 
 Realistic OTE (On\-Target Earnings) for a strong performer is
 **₹1,00,000 – ₹1,25,000/month** 
 , scaling higher as your recurring portfolio builds.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years in B2B technology sales (SaaS, software, or IT products).
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional, confident spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking peer\-to\-peer with global founders.
* **Business Acumen:** 
 A deep curiosity about business metrics. You should be able to intelligently discuss Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), conversion rates, return logistics, and profit margins—not just recite software features.
* **Resilience:** 
 Comfortable owning a revenue target, managing a pipeline, and navigating the reality of B2B sales.
* *Advantageous:* 
 Familiarity with Shopify/e\-commerce ecosystems, strong CRM discipline, and experience in international markets.



  





**What to Expect** 




 You will work directly with the founders, receiving hands\-on product training from day one. You are joining early enough that whoever successfully builds this function will eventually lead it.
 



 We value transparency: building a solid client base takes time, and we maintain a clear performance bar for the first three months, which will be transparently discussed prior to an offer. We offer a dynamic environment where you experience real ownership rather than just acting as a cog in an existing machine.
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live mock sales call (product details will be provided in advance).

Talking to your customer and turning that conversation into a sale isn't luck it's a skill, and this internship teaches it to you from the ground up.  What you get in return: Freshers welcome to apply. Full training from us, real sales experience, a salary, performance\-based incentives, and a strong reference if you do well.

title: Sales Development Representative (US Market)
description:
**Company Description:** 




 SalesOne helps B2B companies scale revenue without the complexity of building and managing internal outbound sales teams. The company supports startups and growth\-stage businesses with end\-to\-end outbound execution, including ICP definition, lead research, list building, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, appointment setting, and sales operations. Its data\-driven approach is designed to create predictable pipeline growth by aligning strategy and execution. By consistently generating qualified meetings, SalesOne enables founders and leadership teams to focus on closing deals. SalesOne partners with B2B organizations across industries to improve outbound performance, streamline sales systems, and accelerate go\-to\-market results.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 Outbound Sales Representative(US Market) is a full\-time, onsite role based in Kochi. This role is responsible for researching and identifying target accounts, building prospect lists, and executing outbound outreach via email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate qualified meetings with US\-based decision\-makers. The individual will qualify leads through discovery conversations, understand prospect needs, and communicate the value of SalesOne’s solutions and services. Day\-to\-day tasks include maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, collaborating with sales and operations teams on campaign strategy, and following structured cadences to ensure consistent pipeline generation. The role also involves meeting and exceeding activity and performance targets, sharing market insights with leadership, and contributing to continuous improvement of outbound messaging and processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Execute outbound sales campaigns through email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other outreach channels.
* Represent client brands professionally during prospect interactions.
* Research target accounts and identify key decision\-makers.
* Qualify leads and schedule meetings for clients.
* Assist clients in developing outbound strategies and engagement plans.
* Manage prospect communications and follow\-up activities.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and activity tracking.
* Collaborate with Account Managers to ensure pipeline visibility and meeting success.
* Utilize AI\-powered sales tools and automation platforms to maximize outreach effectiveness.
* Support international clients across different regions and time zones.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 1\-2 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, Inside/Outside Sales, or Outbound Prospecting.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience handling international clients or global prospects is preferred.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, or similar tools.
* Comfortable using modern sales engagement and prospecting tools.
* Strong ability to build rapport, qualify opportunities, and drive conversations forward.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and target\-driven mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced SaaS and sales\-tech environment.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* B2B SaaS sales experience.
* Experience handling clients from the US/UK region
* Cold calling and email outreach expertise.
* Pipeline management knowledge.
* Experience with AI\-enabled sales platforms.
* Understanding of outbound sales metrics and reporting.



  





**Success Metrics:** 



* Qualified meetings booked.
* Pipeline contribution.
* Outreach performance.
* Lead qualification quality.
* Client satisfaction.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Opportunity to work with a growing SaaS product.
* Career growth and learning opportunities.
* Exposure to B2B sales and business development.
* Collaborative and performance\-driven work environment.
* Tools: A dedicated Apple MacBook (Apple silicon\-based) will be provided during your employment.
* Work Week: A 5\-day workweek schedule.
